title: Martial Arts
subtitle: 本課限定語境：martial arts = systems or traditions of trained combat techniques, often involving
description: 本課限定語境：martial arts = systems or traditions of trained combat techniques, often involving striking, grappling, weapons, discipline, sport, self-defence, or cultural practice · 「武術；格鬥技；武道」

words.note: 表示以對抗、比賽和規則為核心的格鬥運動。
words.example: Boxing and wrestling are well-known combat sports.
words.exampleZh: 拳擊和摔跤都是著名的格鬥運動。

exercises.original: The club offers martial arts such as boxing, wrestling, and kickboxing.
exercises.zh: 俱樂部提供拳擊、摔跤和踢拳等格鬥運動。
exercises.upgrade: A. combat sports · 格鬥運動

options.explanation: boxing、wrestling、kickboxing 都有明確競賽形式和規則，是典型 combat sports。
這三者可以用於自衛，但題句列的是競技型運動。
語義較廣，可以包括，但不如 combat sports 精確表達競賽性。
只說是運動課，沒有格鬥核心。
指訓練活動，不是這些運動類別本身。

exercises.original: Many martial arts now have organized competitions and weight classes.
exercises.zh: 很多格鬥運動現在都有正式比賽和重量級別。
exercises.upgrade: B. combat sports · 格鬥運動

options.explanation: 可以包含競技系統，但不一定有正式 competition。
organized competitions 和 weight classes 是最強線索。
更廣，可能包含非競技武術。
重點是防身，不一定有體重級別或比賽。
軍事操練不是體育競賽。

exercises.original: The university has a society for students interested in competitive martial arts.
exercises.zh: 大學設有供對競技格鬥運動有興趣學生參加的學會。
exercises.upgrade: The university has a society for students interested in combat sports.

options.explanation: 可能重文化／傳統而非競賽。

words.meaning: 格鬥技術體系；格鬥流派
words.note: 表示有系統地訓練格鬥技巧、方法和紀律的不同體系。
words.example: The centre teaches several fighting disciplines.
words.exampleZh: 該中心教授多種格鬥技術體系。

exercises.original: The school teaches several martial arts from different countries.
exercises.zh: 學校教授來自不同國家的多種格鬥技術體系。
exercises.upgrade: A. fighting disciplines · 格鬥技術體系

options.explanation: 不同國家、不同系統，最適合以 discipline 概括。
有些體系未必以比賽為主。

exercises.original: Students can choose between several traditional martial arts.
exercises.zh: 學生可以在多種傳統格鬥體系中選擇。
exercises.upgrade: Students can choose between several traditional fighting disciplines.

options.explanation: traditional + 多種系統最適合 discipline。
傳統 martial arts 不一定有競賽。

exercises.original: The instructor has experience in a number of martial arts.
exercises.zh: 這位教練有多種格鬥技術體系的經驗。
exercises.upgrade: The instructor has experience in a number of fighting disciplines.

options.explanation: 把 martial arts 的目的限制成防身。
自然概括不同格鬥訓練體系。

words.meaning: 格鬥訓練體系；戰鬥技術體系
words.note: 較正式地表示有組織、有紀律的戰鬥訓練系統。
words.example: Students can study a range of traditional combat disciplines.
words.exampleZh: 學生可以學習多種傳統格鬥訓練體系。

exercises.original: The academy focuses on traditional martial arts with strict technical training.
exercises.zh: 學院專注於有嚴格技術訓練的傳統格鬥體系。
exercises.upgrade: The academy focuses on traditional combat disciplines with strict technical training.

options.explanation: strict technical training + traditional system 很符合較正式的 discipline 語感。
強調休閒，不一定是格鬥。
可被理解為遊戲／比賽，不是完整體系。

exercises.original: The centre preserves several historic martial arts.
exercises.zh: 中心保存數種歷史悠久的格鬥訓練體系。
exercises.upgrade: The centre preserves several historic combat disciplines.

options.explanation: historic + preserved system 指完整傳統格鬥體系。

exercises.original: Researchers compared the training methods used in different martial arts.
exercises.zh: 研究人員比較不同格鬥體系使用的訓練方法。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers compared the training methods used in different combat disciplines.

options.explanation: 研究「不同體系的訓練方法」時很自然。
軍事戰役，不是訓練體系。

words.note: 強調格鬥不只是運動，也是一套技巧、方法和傳統。
words.example: He has studied Asian fighting arts for many years.
words.exampleZh: 他多年來一直研習亞洲格鬥技藝。

exercises.original: He has studied Asian martial arts for more than twenty years.
exercises.zh: 他研習亞洲格鬥技藝超過二十年。
exercises.upgrade: He has studied Asian fighting arts for more than twenty years.

options.explanation: 長期研習亞洲格鬥傳統，arts 能保留技藝／傳統色彩。

exercises.original: The festival demonstrated martial arts from several cultural traditions.
exercises.zh: 節慶展示了來自數種文化傳統的格鬥技藝。
exercises.upgrade: The festival demonstrated fighting arts from several cultural traditions.

options.explanation: 訓練活動未必突出文化傳統。
festival + cultural traditions 更適合 arts 而不是 sports。
題句是 demonstration，不一定是比賽。

exercises.original: The museum exhibition explores the history of martial arts.
exercises.zh: 博物館展覽探討格鬥技藝的歷史。
exercises.upgrade: The museum exhibition explores the history of fighting arts.

options.explanation: 歷史與文化展覽語境中，arts 能保留技藝與傳統意味。
表示格鬥表現的藝術性，不是武術體系。

words.note: 表示主要目的是保護自己、應對威脅的格鬥系統。
words.example: The course introduces several practical self-defence systems.
words.exampleZh: 課程介紹數種實用自衛術體系。

exercises.original: The course teaches martial arts designed mainly for personal protection.
exercises.zh: 課程教授主要用於個人保護的自衛術體系。
exercises.upgrade: The course teaches self-defence systems designed mainly for personal protection.

options.explanation: 競技規則不是題句重點。
personal protection 是最直接線索。
太廣，不能突出防身用途。

exercises.original: Some martial arts focus more on practical protection than competition.
exercises.zh: 有些武術更重實用防身，而不是競賽。
exercises.upgrade: Some self-defence systems focus more on practical protection than competition.

options.explanation: 題句明確對比 protection 和 competition。
self-defence 通常不這樣複數化作體系名稱。

exercises.original: The instructor combines martial arts with escape techniques and situational awareness.
exercises.zh: 教練把自衛術與脫身技巧及環境警覺結合。
exercises.upgrade: The instructor combines self-defence systems with escape techniques and situational awareness.

options.explanation: escape techniques + situational awareness 都強烈指向防身用途。
比賽通常不以 situational awareness 為核心。
是所有格，且這裡需要複數類別。

words.note: 表示學習格鬥技巧的訓練活動。
words.example: The program combines fitness work with combat training.
words.exampleZh: 該計劃結合體能訓練和格鬥訓練。

exercises.original: The program combines fitness with martial arts practice.
exercises.zh: 該計劃把體能訓練和格鬥訓練結合。
exercises.upgrade: The program combines fitness with combat training.

options.explanation: 指完整體系，不是訓練活動本身。
和 fitness 並列時，重點是訓練活動。

exercises.original: The academy includes martial arts in its physical training program.
exercises.zh: 學院在體能訓練計劃中加入格鬥訓練。
exercises.upgrade: The academy includes combat training in its physical training program.

options.explanation: program 中加入的是訓練內容，不是某一特定 martial art 類別。

exercises.original: Recruits receive martial arts instruction alongside strength and endurance work.
exercises.zh: 受訓人員接受格鬥訓練，同時進行力量和耐力訓練。
exercises.upgrade: Recruits receive combat training alongside strength and endurance work.

options.explanation: recruits + strength/endurance 明確是訓練活動語境。
指教練／訓練器材，不是 training。

words.note: 較正式地表示有技術、規範、紀律和傳統的武術體系。
words.example: The academy offers instruction in several martial disciplines.
words.exampleZh: 學院教授數種武術體系。

exercises.original: The academy offers instruction in several martial arts.
exercises.zh: 學院教授數種武術訓練體系。
exercises.upgrade: The academy offers instruction in several martial disciplines.

exercises.original: Students are expected to show discipline and respect when studying martial arts.
exercises.zh: 學生研習武道時應展現紀律和尊重。
exercises.upgrade: Students are expected to show discipline and respect when studying martial disciplines.

options.explanation: discipline + respect 特別配合 structured martial traditions 的語感。

exercises.original: The school treats martial arts as systems of technique, discipline, and tradition.
exercises.zh: 學校把武術視為結合技巧、紀律和傳統的訓練體系。
exercises.upgrade: The school treats martial disciplines as systems of technique, discipline, and tradition.

options.explanation: technique + discipline + tradition 正是此表達的強項。

falseSynonyms.zh: 打鬥 ≠ 武術 fighting 只是打鬥行為。 martial arts 是系統化訓練。
拳擊 ≠ 所有 martial arts boxing 是一種 combat sport／fighting discipline，只是其中一類。
摔跤 ≠ 所有 martial arts 同樣只是特定格鬥體系。
自衛 ≠ 所有 martial arts self-defence 是目的／功能。 martial arts 可以同時包含：
軍事訓練 ≠ 武術 military training 範圍更廣，還包括：
運動 ≠ 武術 martial arts 可以是 exercise，但 exercise 不一定涉及格鬥。
詞義差異 - martial = 戰爭的；軍事的；武術相關的 - martial arts = 武術 不能單獨用 martial 代替 martial arts。
詞形差異 - combat = 戰鬥；格鬥 - combatant = 戰鬥人員 - combat sport = 格鬥運動
